name: Yoo Ji-tae
bio: Yoo Ji-tae (유지태) is a South Korean actor, film director, screenplay writer, and former fashion model. He was born on April 13th 1976. He is married to actress Kim Hyo-jin.

credits.title: K-POP: The Debut
credits.overview: Lizzy Lee, a young Korean-American woman, has spent her life following the path her family chose for her, but when she earns a spot in a globally televised competition to form the next K-pop girl group, she travels to Seoul, South Korea, to pursue the dream she must still keep hidden.

credits.title: Seven O'Clock Breakfast Club for the Brokenhearted
credits.overview: "I just got dumped. Will you have breakfast with me?" At a breakfast club, heartbroken Sa-gang and Ji-hoon stumble upon mysterious "breakup souvenirs." Each item holds a secret pain, reflecting their own. Will they find the souvenir's owner?

credits.title: Talk to Her
credits.overview: Sean is a Korean-American aspiring filmmaker who came to Korea with dreams of becoming the next BONG Joon Ho. Hyejeong, a budding actress who faced numerous challenges studying acting in the United States, struggled to succeed in Korea. Despite their vastly different paths, they still hold onto their dreams.

credits.overview: Failed architect, engineer and vicious murderer Jack narrates the details of some of his most elaborately orchestrated crimes, each of them a towering piece of art that defines his life's work as a serial killer for twelve years.

credits.overview: A group of swindlers unite to hunt down an infamous con man who was known dead, amid their hidden motives and deception.

credits.overview: A washed-up bowling legend and his woman are drowning in debt. They decide to recruit an autistic genius to win money playing the game.

credits.overview: Old Days is a documentary about Park Chan-wook's original masterpiece, Oldboy. It was created for Plain Archive's Blu-ray release and first screened at the Jeonju International Film Festival.

After their reminiscences, they finally decide to go in search of the young woman each had romanced years earlier.
